how_it_works: The app turns the results a parent types in into a suggested starting level. Rules are checked from top to bottom; the first rule whose conditions are all true is the suggestion. A condition that is null has not been written yet: while any rule still has a null condition, the app makes no suggestion and the parent picks a level. Set "always": true on a last rule to make it the fallback. The parent can always override the suggestion.

reader_quiz.min_total: points in sections A-D added together are at least this
reader_quiz.min_section: points in the named section are at least this, e.g. {"B": 4}
reader_quiz.min_playing_yes: number of 'Yes' answers in section E (playing check) is at least this

prereader_checklist.min_usually: number of 'Usually' answers is at least this
prereader_checklist.min_usually_in: number of 'Usually' answers in the named section is at least this, e.g. {"S": 2}
prereader_checklist.max_not_yet: number of 'Not yet' answers is at most this
